notes.text: Bracketed [...] data functions are replaced at runtime. Keep them exactly; data functions are scoped, usually to a character (for example [ROOT.Char.GetLadyLord]).
Formatting uses #tag text#! (for example #P, #N, #E, #bold, #italic); tags combine with ';' as in #high;bold. Icons are @icon_name!; $key$ inserts another localization key.
[concept_key|E] and [Concept('concept_key','text')|E] are game concept links. Dropping one loses the tooltip even if the plain word is translated.

zh-CN.text: 中文本地化里代词命令输出他/她；中文没有主格宾格之分，任何代词命令都可作主语或宾语。
因中文习惯省略重复的代词命令是合理的，前提是指代仍然清楚；不要把代词命令写死成“他”或“她”。没有必要时，应尽量保持与原文相同的命令引用。

suffixes.OrMe: prints 'me' when the character is the player
suffixes.OrMy: prints 'my' when the character is the player

scopes.Char: character promote of the current scope

GetHerHim.meaning: pronoun her or him by gender

GetHerHis.meaning: pronoun her or his by gender

GetHerHisMy.meaning: her, his, or my when the character is the player

GetHersHis.meaning: possessive pronoun hers or his by gender

GetHerselfHimself.meaning: reflexive pronoun herself or himself by gender

GetSheHe.meaning: pronoun she or he by gender

GetDaughterSonPossessive.meaning: possessive daughter's or son's by gender

GetFirstName.meaning: character's first name; accepts name suffixes

GetFullName.meaning: character's full name; accepts name suffixes

GetTrait.meaning: the named trait; usually followed by .GetName(...)

GetTitleByKey.meaning: the named title; usually followed by .GetName

Concept.meaning: game concept link with custom text: Concept('concept_key','text'); translate only the text argument
